epics.title: Falsification Finding Remediation Cycle
epics.jtbd: When maintaining the project codebase, I want to resolve all confirmed falsification findings, so that technical debt is eliminated and infrastructure standards are strictly upheld.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease the number of unresolved falsification findings across the project from 8 to 0
epics.tocConstraintRef: Technical debt resolution and codebase standards enforcement
requirements: R1: Address codebase and infrastructure violations by removing target/surefire-reports from version control, updating Flyway migrations to use TIMESTAMPTZ and gen_random_uuid() without IF NOT EXISTS, and adding required *Test.java and contract tests.

R2: Correct project documentation and domain alignment by ensuring all task plans specify explicit measurable starting baselines for their sixSigmaMetric, and refocusing efforts on the actual epidemiological knowledge base domain.

slices.title: Apply Direct Patches for Falsification Findings
slices.jtbd: When implementing the falsification fixes for this epic, I want to patch the existing code directly, so that all eight confirmed findings are resolved without creating new layers.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the presence of invalid Flyway schemas,
When the codebase is patched to resolve the findings directly,
Then Flyway schemas use TIMESTAMPTZ and gen_random_uuid() without IF NOT EXISTS.
Given task plans lacking explicit baselines,
When the project documentation is corrected,
Then all task plans contain explicit numeric baselines.
Given the presence of committed test results,
When the build artifacts are removed from version control,
Then target/surefire-reports are ignored and API endpoints include complete test coverage.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the number of failing compliance and schema validations in the CI pipeline from 8 to 0
